name: Progate Group Corporation
summary: Progate Group Corporation is a global provider of comprehensive integrated circuit (IC) design services. The company specializes in end-to-end solutions spanning a wide spectrum of IC development needs. Its offerings include full ASIC development, implementation platform services, and complete product turnkey solutions. Progate's capabilities extend to MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) and cyber shuttle programs, advanced CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) turnkey, gate array turnkey, and conversions from FPDA to ASIC. Furthermore, it provides specialized solutions such as embedded flash, high voltage, and System-on-Chip (SoC) platform turnkey services. Additional offerings encompass IP design, APR (Automatic Place and Route) layout, COT (Customer-Owned Tooling)/foundry turnkey, and sophisticated system-in-package (SiP) and 3D package turnkey solutions. Beyond these comprehensive design services, Progate is also a key provider of diverse IP (Intellectual Property) cores. This IP portfolio features CPU, digital, mixed-signal, and analog IPs, alongside specialized IO and memory IPs, as well as high-speed interface PHY services. Established in 1991, Progate Group Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
